prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: In the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project, the team established a three-phase rollout beginning with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May. Key decisions included the allocation of two part-time coordinators for the pilot, the integration of the on-premise warehouse management system, and an initial budget consideration of up to $50,000, subject to finance committee review after the pilot in June. Action items were assigned to revise the schedule, document the integration approach, and confirm coordinator allocation.
